definitions.masked_genotype_cells: missing in the masked stream but not in the unmasked stream, same record and sample
definitions.missing_genotype_cells: a GT with any missing allele in the unmasked stream
definitions.filter_buckets: pass_records: FILTER=PASS; failed_filter_records: a named filter code; unfiltered_records: FILTER='.', meaning no filter was applied
definitions.variant_type_split: '<stratum>:snp' and '<stratum>:indel' count the same region's records by type; their bases are the stratum's bases, so each density is per type
definitions.non_reference_calls: a fully called GT with at least one non-reference allele
definitions.heterozygous_calls: a fully called GT with two different alleles
definitions.homozygous_alt_calls: a fully called GT whose alleles are one and the same non-reference allele

limitations: descriptive only: counts and rates by stratum, not accuracy; no truth set exists for this reference

masked_genotype_cells come from the illustrative Issue #64 policy min_dp=10, min_gq=20, which is not a default and was not calibrated
differences between strata reflect sequence context, depth and this cohort's composition together; they are not separable here
records straddling a stratum edge are not counted in that stratum (see strata[].records_straddling_edge_not_counted)
